The Analytics Engineering team at DoorDash is embedded within the Analytics and Data Engineering Orgs, and is responsible for building internal data products that scale decision-making across business teams and drive efficiency in our operations. Data is fundamental to DoorDash’s success, and this team plays a critical role in enabling high-impact, data-driven solutions across Product, Operations, Finance, and more.

About The Role

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll play a key role in building and scaling the data foundations that enable fast, reliable, and actionable insights. You’ll work closely with partner teams to drive end-to-end analytics initiatives, working alongside Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Operators.

This is a highly technical role where you'll be a driving force behind the analytics stack, delivering trusted data and metrics that support decision-making at all levels of the company. If you're energized by solving technical problems with data and are comfortable being deeply embedded across several domains, this role is for you!

You're Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…


Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, and business stakeholders to understand business needs, and translate that scope into data requirements
Identify key business questions and problems to solve for, and generate insights by developing structured solutions to resolve them
Lead the development of data products and self-serve tools that enable analytics to scale across the company
Build and maintain canonical datasets by developing high-volume, reliable ETL/ELT pipelines using data lake and data warehousing concepts
Design metrics and data visualizations with dashboarding tools like Tableau, Sigma, and Mode
Be a cross-functional champion at upholding high data integrity standards to increase reusability, readability and standardization


We're Excited About You Because You Have…


A degree in Math, Physics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a similar domain
2-6+ years of experience working in business intelligence, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role
Strong proficiency in SQL for data transformation, comfort in at least one functional/OOP language such as Python or Scala
Experience in creating compelling reporting and data visualization solutions using dashboarding tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Sigma)
Familiarity with database fundamentals (e.g. S3, Trino, Hive, Spark), and experience with SQL performance tuning
Experience in writing data quality checks to validate data integrity (e.g., Pydeequ, Great Expectations)
Strong communication skills and experience working with technical and non-technical teams
Comfortable working in fast paced environment, self starter and self organizing
Ability to think strategically, analyze and interpret market and consumer information

description:

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Willow Wealth

Willow Wealth is a leading platform for private market investing, connecting individual investors with curated opportunities across real estate, private credit, private equity, and more. Founded in 2015, the platform has grown to serve more than 500,000 members with $6.9B+ invested since inception. The company has raised over $250M from leading institutional investors, such as Redbird, Tarsadia, Mayfair, StepStone, and Edison Partners.

About The Role

Willow Wealth is seeking a Senior Data Engineer who will be responsible for owning and improving the company's data stack. This includes expanding our data warehouse, building ingestion processes between different company tools, and streamlining reporting processes. As part of a small but wide-reaching data team, you will have ample opportunity to own large parts of our tech stack and to plan new projects to improve the organization.

After thirty days, this person is expected to become familiar with the various parts of our data stack, such as the data warehouse, dimensional model design, scheduling & ETL processes. They will have enough knowledge to work on ingesting new data, refactoring dbt models, and ensuring downstream reporting maintains accuracy.

After a year, this person should be the technical owner and go-to person for parts of our data stack. It is expected that they will proactively consider improvements to their areas of ownership. They should be able to holistically understand the data stack and how changes to one part might affect others. They not only adhere to best practices but are able to add to them as well.

Key Responsibilities


Build and streamline Python processes to ingest data from various sources into and out of our data warehouse
Maintain and expand data in data warehouse
Improve and standardize data quality
Collaborate with engineering and analysts to incorporate upstream data changes and downstream data requests
Improve and automate team processes


Qualifications


4+ years of experience in data engineering
Fluency in SQL and Python
Proficiency with relational databases and dimensional modelling
Expertise building ETL processes
Familiarity with BI tools
Experience with the following tools is preferred but not required:
Snowflake
Looker
Dagster
Docker

What’s in it for you

Competitive compensation package, including equity

Health, dental & vision coverage with FSA/HSA options

Unlimited PTO

401k match

Commuter benefit

Life insurance

Wellness stipend

This is a New York-based role. The base salary range for this position is USD 170,000 to 190,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications. This role is eligible for equity compensation as part of the total compensation package.

Work on data products that directly support major enterprise customer opportunities

Strong experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data infrastructure

Experience with tools such as dbt, Dagster, Airflow, or similar orchestration platforms

Experience integrating with sales and marketing systems of record
Experience building data products for enterprise customers

Position Overview




THIS IS A HYBRID ROLE BASED IN MONTVALE, NJ




The Senior Power BI Developer owns the dashboards and reporting our business runs on. This is a Power BI–first, stakeholder-facing role: the majority of the work is designing, building, and maintaining Power BI dashboards — and partnering directly with Finance, Operations, Sales, and Marketing to turn ambiguous business questions into clear, trusted, decision-ready analytics.

You'll work on top of a curated BigQuery reporting layer maintained by our data engineering function, so you can focus on the semantic model, the metrics, the visuals, and the business conversation — not on building pipelines. A baseline understanding of data architecture (how a layered warehouse and dimensional models are structured) is important so you can collaborate effectively with data engineering and design performant, reliable reports. This role is ideal for someone who is a genuine Power BI craftsperson and equally comfortable sitting with a business leader to figure out what they actually need.




Essential Job Functions




Dashboard & Report Development (the core of the role)

Build and maintain Power BI dashboards — design, develop, and iterate interactive dashboards and reports on the curated reporting layer, using DAX, Power Query (M), and strong data-modeling and visualization practices.
Own the Power BI semantic model — build and maintain star-schema data models, relationships, measures, and calculation logic that are performant and reusable across reports.
Optimize performance — tune models, DAX, and queries for speed and reliability; make deliberate Import vs. DirectQuery choices and manage refresh/query cost against BigQuery.




Stakeholder Partnership & Business Intelligence

Understand the business problem — partner with Finance, Operations, Sales, and Marketing to translate ambiguous questions into well-defined KPIs, metric definitions, and the right visuals — confirming the requirement before building.
Tell the story — apply data-visualization best practices to turn data into clear, usable insight — not just charts, but answers a stakeholder can act on.
Enable self-service — promote trusted, well-documented reports and datasets, and help business users get value from them independently.
Document and build repeatable processes — maintain strong, clear documentation of requirements, metric definitions, and reporting logic, and establish repeatable processes and standards for how reporting requests are intake, prioritized, built, and validated.




Publishing, Governance & Report Lifecycle

Deploy and operate in the Power BI Service — publish and manage workspaces, apps, and scheduled/gateway-managed refreshes; own reports through their full lifecycle including maintenance, troubleshooting, and UAT.
Apply security and governance — implement row-level security (RLS) and follow governance best practices so the right people see the right data.
Document — maintain metric definitions, data-model documentation, and report catalogs so reporting is understandable and maintainable.




Collaboration with Data Engineering

Work the DE / BI seam — the data engineering function owns ingestion, pipelines, and the raw/transformed layers; you own the reporting layer and everything Power BI. Partner on data contracts, required datasets, freshness expectations, and reporting-layer schema so dashboards are built on a trusted foundation.




Required Qualifications

Core must-haves

Power BI mastery — hands-on expertise across DAX, Power Query (M), data modeling, and row-level security — able to build and maintain dashboards independently, end to end.
Advanced SQL — writing and optimizing complex queries (BigQuery preferred).
Stakeholder & requirements skill — proven ability to gather requirements, translate business questions into metrics, and communicate clearly with non-technical audiences.
Data-visualization judgment — a strong sense for visual best practices, dashboard UX, and data storytelling.
Baseline data architecture understanding — dimensional modeling (star/snowflake), layered warehouse concepts, and how curated datasets are produced — enough to collaborate with data engineering and design reliable reports.

Plus

5–7 years in business intelligence, Power BI development, analytics, or a related field.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.
Strong problem-solving, a business-first mindset, and excellent cross-functional communication.
Ability to connect Power BI directly to a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred), not just flat files.

title: Senior Technical Data & AI Enablement Analyst - Legal, Compliance & Policy Org
description:
Overview

At Intuit, we help over 100 million people and businesses around the world feel more confident about their money. We are the proud makers of TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp. Our mission is to power prosperity around the world. We do this by staying customer-obsessed and using data and AI to solve the biggest financial challenges for our customers.

The Legal Solutions & Strategy team is looking for a Senior Technical Data & AI Enablement Analyst to join our team. As a Senior Technical Data & AI Enablement Analyst, you will be part of a smart, collaborative team focused on modernizing how Intuit's legal function leverages data, automation, and AI. In this role you will work closely with legal operations, counsel, engineering, and other internal stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities where data insights and AI-powered tools can make legal and compliance workflows faster, smarter, and more efficient. You will help evaluate, implement, and optimize AI and technology solutions, build reporting and dashboards that surface actionable insights, and drive business requirements and process improvements across the legal organization. The role requires a self-motivated individual with strong analytical and interpersonal skills who excels in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities


Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards and reporting that give LCPO (Legal, Compliance & Policy Org) stakeholders real-time visibility into portfolio health, initiative progress, tool adoption, workflow performance, and capacity.
Track success metrics and anchor metrics across LCPO strategic initiatives — including AI-assisted reviews, contract lifecycle management, workflow enablement, and the Knowledge Management System — so every workstream has trackable, data-backed outcomes.
Contribute to the LCPO Data Lake ecosystem by building and monitoring data pipelines, supporting usage tracking and governance, and coordinating with FLP Tech (Finance, Legal & Privacy Tech) data engineers on requirements.
Support and scale AI enablement across LCPO workflows, helping evaluate, implement, and optimize AI-powered tools (e.g., AI-assisted review, agentic AI, and AI assistants embedded in team support channels).
Replace manual, repetitive reporting with automated, bot-driven reports and pipelines, reducing turnaround from days to minutes.
Conduct ad hoc and structured analyses to surface bottlenecks, identify problem areas, and provide data-driven insights into current processes and decisions.
Support annual and FY planning cycles with clean, timely data on initiative performance, team activity, resource utilization, and capacity inputs.
Partner with product owners, architects, and data engineers to communicate data needs and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Help enable and upskill other data analysts across the LCPO org, advocating alignment with LCPO data standards, governance, and self-serve analytics practices.
Drive business requirements and process improvements across legal workflows, leading change management for new tools and dashboards, including stakeholder communication, training, and adoption tracking.


Qualifications


BS/MS in computer science or equivalent work experience
Minimum of 5 years of experience in a data analytics or analytical role, ideally supporting a legal, compliance, operations, or comparable business function.
Proficiency with data analysis and business intelligence tools (e.g.Tableau,Quicksight, Qliksense, Excel, Looker, or Google Sheets) and demonstrated ability to build and maintain dashboards that surface actionable insights.
Hands-on experience with the AWS suite (e.g., S3, SES, data lake services) and cloud-based data infrastructure.
Hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines (BPP pipelines etc) and contributing to a data lake/warehouse ecosystem, including data pulls, quality, and governance.
Experience with version control and collaborative development workflows using GitHub (e.g., repositories, branching, pull requests).
Working knowledge of SQL (e.g., Databricks SQL, Athena, BigQuery) and comfort querying, joining, and transforming data from multiple sources.
Familiarity with AI and automation tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) and a demonstrated interest in applying them to make workflows faster and smarter (experience with agentic AI, LLM-based assistants, or workflow automation platforms such as Tonkean is a plus).
Strong ability to define and track success and anchor metrics, and to translate business questions into measurable analytical outputs.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build strong working relationships cross-functionally and within the legal department, and to present recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Focus on understanding client context and working collaboratively with key partners to drive relevant, impactful solutions.
Superior project and time-management skills, including managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Proven history of taking initiative, working independently, and proactively identifying areas of need and generating recommended action plans.
Proven Intellectual curiosity with a demonstrated willingness to dive into new areas.


Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.
